operations.description: Configure the Podman container for service web when activated.

prerequisites.description: Import the module on a NixOS host with Podman as its OCI backend.
Make image docker.io/library/nginx@sha256:a8b39bd9cf0f83869a2162827a0caf6137ddf759d50a171451b335cecc87d236 available for service web.

limitations: Compilation preview. No deployed state was read.
Application health requires an external probe.
Single-host NixOS cannot provide host failover.
